t: Context Saturation to Semantic Compression: Architecting a Fractal Blog for AI Navigation
s: This article details Pipulate's advancement in handling AI's large context windows, introducing semantic compression techniques to transform a digital archive into an AI-navigable fractal library. It explores Gemini's 1-million token capacity and the 'signal of saturation'.
sub: Gemini's 1 million token context window capabilities
